title: Condensed tensor-Hom chain and its precise counit representative
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Put $\Lambda=\mathrm{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] and $\mathcal C_T=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(T,\Lambda)$ with the exact internal-module bounded-constructible predicate [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Write $U=Lf^*$, $G=Rf_*$ for the restricted adjoint pair of [sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors], and $F=Rf_!$, $V=Rf^!$ for the chosen-compactification adjoint pair [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek, sk-def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek]. Write $H_T$ for the internal Hom and use the chosen left-factor adjunction $A\otimes-\dashv H_T(A,-)$ [def-sfb-dc-tensor-hom-adjunction]. Let $\varepsilon:UG\to1$ and $\varepsilon^!:FV\to1$ be the specified counits. Fix $K\in\mathcal C_X$, $L\in\mathcal C_Y$, and a family of isomorphisms $P_B:FK\otimes B\xrightarrow{\sim}F(K\otimes UB)$, natural for all $B\in\mathcal C_Y$. Put $W=H_X(K,VL)$, $E=GW$ and $D=H_Y(FK,L)$. Let $\operatorname{ev}:K\otimes W\to VL$ be evaluation and let
$$\Phi=\operatorname{curry}\bigl(\varepsilon^!_L\circ F(\operatorname{ev})\circ F(1_K\otimes\varepsilon_W)\circ P_E\bigr):E\longrightarrow D.$$
For every $B\in\mathcal C_Y$, the following composite, in the displayed direction, is a bijection natural in $B$:
$$b_B:\operatorname{Hom}_Y(B,E)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_X(UB,W)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_X(K\otimes UB,VL)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(F(K\otimes UB),L)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(FK\otimes B,L)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(B,D).$$
The first and third bijections are the inverse Hom bijections of $U\dashv G$ and $F\dashv V$; the second is uncurrying, the fourth precomposes with $P_B$, and the fifth is currying. For every $h:B\to E$ its value is precisely
$$b_B(h)=\operatorname{curry}\bigl(\varepsilon^!_L\circ F(\operatorname{ev})\circ F(1_K\otimes(\varepsilon_W\circ U(h)))\circ P_B\bigr)=\Phi\circ h.$$
These are equalities for the specified adjunctions, evaluation and natural family $P$, rather than only an assertion that the endpoints are isomorphic. The test objects include $B=E,D$ in the same full bounded-constructible categories; no smoothness, purity, finite-field hypothesis, or coefficient-category comparison is assumed.

proof.text: Work throughout in the stated full categories $\mathcal C_X,\mathcal C_Y$. The restricted functors give $U\dashv G$, the chosen compactification gives $F\dashv V$, and the chosen left-factor tensor adjunctions give the second and fifth bijections. Thus all five arrows in the displayed chain are bijections: the fourth, $a\mapsto a\circ P_B$, has inverse $t\mapsto t\circ P_B^{-1}$. Their composite is $b_B$. Closure under the restricted internal Hom and pushforward puts $W,E,D$ in these same categories, so $E$ and $D$ are permitted test objects.

source.place: displayed Hom-adjunction chain, reconstructed in the condensed categories without coefficient-category identification

proof.text: For $h:B\to E$, the inverse Hom formula for $U\dashv G$ sends $h$ to $q=\varepsilon_W\circ U(h):UB\to W$. The evaluation formula for uncurrying sends $q$ to $\operatorname{ev}\circ(1_K\otimes q)$. The inverse Hom formula for $F\dashv V$ sends this to $\varepsilon^!_L\circ F(\operatorname{ev}\circ(1_K\otimes q))$. Precomposing with $P_B$, then currying, gives exactly the displayed formula for $b_B(h)$ by functoriality of $F$. These formulas refer to the specified counits, not to an unspecified choice of equivalent adjunction.

source.place: displayed Hom-adjunction chain, reconstructed in the condensed categories without coefficient-category identification

proof.text:
Write $r_B$ for the uncurried expression just obtained and $r_E$ for that expression at $h=1_E$. Tensor and functor composition laws, followed by the assumed naturality of $P$, give
$$F(1_K\otimes U(h))\circ P_B=P_E\circ(1_{FK}\otimes h),\qquad r_B=r_E\circ(1_{FK}\otimes h).$$
Naturality in the source of the Hom bijection for $FK\otimes-\dashv H_Y(FK,-)$ now gives $b_B(h)=\operatorname{curry}(r_E)\circ h=\Phi\circ h$. Here $U(1_E)=1_{UE}$ identifies $\operatorname{curry}(r_E)$ with the precise definition of $\Phi$.

source.place: displayed Hom-adjunction chain, reconstructed in the condensed categories without coefficient-category identification

proof.text: For $a:B'\to B$, the last equality gives $b_{B'}(h\circ a)=\Phi\circ h\circ a=b_B(h)\circ a$ by associativity. This is the required naturality on every test object, including $E,D$. No geometric or coefficient comparison enters the calculation.

There is no repair note for the item, so the re-split rules do not apply. The Q07 delivery was marked LAND superseded and the item is still unsplit live, so this delivery is not superseded. Source: sk-thm-sf-tensor-hom.proof.md (main-20261015). The item's chain is that chain reversed with (M,N,L)->(K,L,B), arrows matched one for one, inside D_cons(-,Q̄_ℓ). It identifies no coefficient categories, and the projection family P is a hypothesis, so the target is not weakened. Each cited statement says what its step takes. sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors gives Lf^*⊣Rf_* and K⊗−⊣RHom(K,−), and closure of Rf_*, ⊗ and RHom for Q̄_ℓ. sk-def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek gives Rf_!⊣Rf^! with the right adjoint existing for Q̄_ℓ. def-sfb-dc-tensor-hom-adjunction gives the left-factor adjunction. The two Mathlib leaves give Ψ^{-1}(b)=ε∘F(b) with the two naturality laws, and uncurry(v)=(1⊗v);ev. Step 1: all five arrows are bijections (inverse of −∘P_B is −∘P_B^{-1}) and W, E, D lie in the full categories. Step 2: the formula ε^!_L∘F(ev)∘F(1⊗(ε_W∘Uh))∘P_B, with every arrow's type checked. Step 3: naturality of P plus bifunctoriality of ⊗ give r_B=r_E∘(1⊗h); source naturality of curry then gives b_B(h)=Φh, and U(1_E)=1 identifies curry(r_E) with Φ. Step 4: associativity gives naturality in B. Edge cases agree: f=id with P=id, K=0 or L=0, h=1_E. The citer nt-target-poincare-isiso Step 2 uses exactly bijectivity at B=D and B=E. Not duplicates: lem-pod-hom-chain-counit-formula and lem-pod-structure-hom-chain-realization are the same formal chain on D^b_ctf with fixed stage projection maps, a different coefficient category. All proof dependencies are definitions or Mathlib leaves, so no route issue and no tool_uses entry. One advisory: the uncurry formula is equally the instance F=K⊗− of the adjunction leaf, so the monoidal-category wording of lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws is not needed. No fixes.
